SQL_DOC.P_SQL: BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT APR_NO FROM ICOMAPRH_IF WHERE APR_NO = $APR_NO$ AND APR_COUNT = $APR_COUNT$ ) BEGIN INSERT INTO ICOMAPRH_IF ( APR_NO, APR_COUNT, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, SIGN_CONT, SUBJECT, UP_REMARK, SECURITY_LVL, URGENCY_YN, UP_USER_ID, UP_DATE, UP_TIME, CONSERVATION_YEAR, SMS_YN, SIGN_STATUS, APR_NO_IKEN, IF_FLAG, IF_ACT_YN, IF_ACT_DATE, IF_ACT_TIME ) VALUES ( $APR_NO$ , $APR_COUNT$ , $STATUS$ , $ADD_DATE$ , $ADD_TIME$ , $ADD_USER_ID$ , $CHANGE_DATE$ , $CHANGE_TIME$ , $CHANGE_USER_ID$ , $SIGN_CONT$ , $SUBJECT$ , $UP_REMARK$ , $SECURITY_LVL$ , $URGENCY_YN$ , $UP_USER_ID$ , $UP_DATE$ , $UP_TIME$ , $CONSERVATION_YEAR$ , $SMS_YN$ , $SIGN_STATUS$ , $APR_NO_IKEN$ , 'I' , 'N' , $IF_ACT_DATE$ , $IF_ACT_TIME$ ) END ELSE BEGIN UPDATE ICOMAPRH_IF SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_ACT_YN = 'N' WHERE APR_NO = $APR_NO$ AND APR_COUNT = $APR_COUNT$ END END
